tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /kun rig gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud las zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg bzhi gsungs pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la don dgu yod pa las/ dang po thab bca' ba ni/ thab tha ma khru gang ba'i dbang du byas na/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yod na de'i nub dang / med na gnas khang gi shar phyogs su sa gzhi byi dor legs par byas par rgyar khru gsum pa'i tshangs zur brgyad btab ste/ dbus nas phyogs re rer sor sum cu so drug yod pa la/ sor bzhi pa lnga dang / gnyis pa drug dang / yang bzhi pa gcig ste zlum skor bcu gnyis byas pa'i/ dang po la phyogs gnyis su sor brgyad yod pa ni 'khor lo'i lte ba ste/ zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa ste/ shar nas phyogs bzhir 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / shar lho nas mtshams bzhir spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / ut+pa la bri'o/ /gsum pa la 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug par byas nas sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan ma bris te/ de yan chad ni thab nang gi rgya tshad khru gang ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni thab kyi kha khyer te/ gzhi ser po la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa khor yug tu bri/ lnga pa ni mu ran te/ gzhi dkar po la sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor mar bri/ drug pa ni thab kyi kha bad de/ gzhi ljang gu la rin po che ser po 'khor bar bri/ bdun pa ni thab kyi kha 'phyang ba ste/ gzhi dkar po la pad+ma dmar po 'khor bar bri/ brgyad pa dang / dgu pa dang / bcu pa gsum ni lha snam phyogs mdog can te/ dang po la phyogs bzhir sgo ba'i mtshan ma dang / mtshams bzhir sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mtshan ma bri/ gnyis pa la byang sems bcu drug gsum pa la nyan thos rang rgyal/

khro bo bcu drug gi mtshan ma bri/ bcu gcig pa la gzhi sngon po la dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs 'jig rten pa'i khor yug gi mtshan ma rnams bri/ bcu gnyis pa la grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje bris te/ thab rkyang gi lugs so/ /yang thab dkyil 'khor dang 'brel bar byed na rgyar khru bzhi dang sor brgyad pa'i tshangs thig btab nas zlum thig bdun pa yan chad snga ma bzhin byas la/ de'i phyi rol du sor lnga pa gnyis kyis logs thig gru bzhir btab pa ni cha chen gnyis yin pas rtsig pa nas mda' yab kyi bar gyi sgo la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas sor lnga la rta babs bang rim bzhi/ de nas sor lnga la pad+ma/ chos 'khor/ gdugs bya/ des nas mda' yab kyi zur nas khor yug la sor gnyis/ rdo rwa la sor gcig me ri la sor gsum/ zla phyed rdo rje la sor gnyis bskor/ de ltar bris pa'i nang gi sgo bzhi la sgo ba bzhi dang / grwa bzhi la sgeg sogs brgyad/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon la byang sems dang nyan rang rnams dang / rwa rtsa la khro bo bcu drug ste/ kun rig gi sgo rkyang gi lugs ltar thams cad rdul tshon gyis bri'o/ /gnyis pa bud shing bsham pa ni/ srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam po'am/ 'o ma can gyi shing sor brgyad pa yan chad khru gang tsam brtsigs nas nang du me tshang bcas la gzhag go /gsum pa mchod pa sogs bsham pa ni/ thab kyi g.yas rang gi g.yon du mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ gzhi bdag dang me lha'i dkar gtor gnyis kyang bsham/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na cha gsum sogs kyi gtor ma lnga po'ang thab kyi rgyab tu bsham/ gzhan yang gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ bla re sogs kyis brgyan/ bzhi pa bsreg rdzas bsham pa ni/ thab kyi g.yon rang gi g.yas su bsreg rdzas rnams gsham ste/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan la/ mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi dang / /'bras yos yungs kar bsres pa dang / /de yi rus pa sha la sogs/

/med na ming nas smos te bya/ /mar dang 'o ma til bsgos la/ /til dang yungs kar 'bras rnams la/ /dri yi chu yis legs bkang ste/ /zhes sogs dang / til dang yungs kar 'bras rnams dang / /ra yi 'o mar ldan pa la/ /dri yis bskus pa'i yam shing gis/ /zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / lag len la bsreg rdzas tshang ma byed de/ sor brgyad pa'i yam shing mang po dang / mar dkar kyi khu ba dang / til dang / bza' ba sna tshogs bsregs pa'i zas mchog dang / 'bras drus pa dang / 'bras so ba dang / nas dang / gro dang / sran ma dang / dūrba dang / ku sha ste/ rdzas bcu gcig po rim pa bzhin du bshams pa'am/ yang na yam shing / mar/ til/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams ma gtogs pa'i bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams snod che ba gcig tu bsres nas bshams te/ rtsa rig bzlas shing 'bul ba la dgongs la/ sngags so sos 'bul ba na bsre mi rung ngo / /gzhan yang rang gi mdun gyi g.yas su rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgang blugs gzar kha sbyar la/ rdo rje'i g.yas su dung chos dri'i chus bkang ba/ ku sha'i chun po dang bcas pa'i gsang chu'ang bsham mo/ /lnga pa sgrub pa po'i yan lag ni/ dus snga dro/ chas gos dkar po gyon te/ thab khung gi nub phyogs nas shar du kha bltas te sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ nad gdon dang sdig sgrib zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ srung 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song ba'i bdag skyed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bzlas pa dang / mchod bstod yan chad bya/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ cha gsum yan chad tshar ba'i skabs su thab drung du bsdad la sbyin sreg la 'jug pa yin gyi/ thab drung du mngon rtogs bsgom dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /drug pa me sbar ba ni/ ras mde'i rtse mo mar me las sbar ba rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod de shar lho nas thab dbus su bcug nas/ ag+ne dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing blugs gzar lan gsum gyis me gso'o/ /de nas ku sha 'bul na skabs 'dir 'bul zhing / gang ltar yang bsang chus rdzas rnams la gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shūn+ya tā sogs brjod pas/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon nas zhal zas kyi bar dang / gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang / yam shing mar til la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes brjod pas ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang / oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /yang thab khung bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ thab khung mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las oṃ bha yongs su gyur pa las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu khyud rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ ces brjod/ bdun pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha spyan drangs shing mchod bstod sogs bya ba la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na rin po che dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ra skyes dang pad+ma dkar po la gnas pa spyan drangs te/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ/

tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma/ pra sā dha ka kā ru ṇa kṛ ta/ sarba ar+tha a smin sa ni hi to bha wa/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas byon zan dbul ba'am med na'ang rung ste/ oṃ ag+na ye re re la sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bsreg rdzas ni 'og tu 'bul bar bshad do/ /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing se gol brdab/ ma lus sems can zhes sogs sh+lau ka gsum dang / dzaḥhūm̐ sogs brjod de/ thab kyi shar du byon pa la/ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ gyis gdan dbul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod de/ mnyes bzhin du me lha'i lto ba yangs par bzhugs/ zhes brjod/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer dang / rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bsgrub bya'i sdig sgrib rnams bkug ste me la thim pas sdig sgrib thams cad mes bsregs par gyur/ ces brjod/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / ye shes bskal pa sogs kyis spyan drang ba dang gdan phul nas/ me lha'i lto ba yangs par bzhugs/ /zhes brjod la/ ma hā kro dha rā dza sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ chos nyid stong pa sogs kyis bstod do/ /de nas thog mar me lha la bsreg rdzas dbul te/ oṃ ag+na ye che ge mo ming 'di zhes bya bas gtsor byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/

zhes pa mar dang / rdzas gzhan bcu po'i sngags/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ oṃ ma hā puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā bi dza ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī ye swāhā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe swāhā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i thog mthar spel tshig re re'i bar du sngags rkyang lan lnga ste/ bdun bdun gyis dbul/ de nas khams gsum rnam rgyal la satwa kro dha'i rjes su spel tshig dang bcas pa'i rdzas bcu gcig po gong bzhin dbul/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang / byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkon mchog gsum la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ bud+dha dharma saṅgā bh+yaḥsngon du 'gro ba'i spel tshig dang bcas pas rdzas bcu gcig po gong bzhin phul la/ bud+dha dharmā saṅgā bh+yaḥsngon du 'gro bas mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /sogs sh+lau ka gsum gyis bstod/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi zhes sogs gsol ba gdab/ slar yang me lha la bsreg rdzas lan gsum dbul lo/ /yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa zhes pa nas/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi lto bar pad zla'i gdan la 'khod/ ces brjod la badz+ra satwa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ gi rjes su spel tshig dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin phul la yang mchod bstod bya'o/

/de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ gyi bar dkyil chog bzhin byas la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar rang rang gi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbus su seng ge'i khri'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad ces sogs gsal gdab/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas lha rnams kyi gnas gsum byin brlab bya/ dbang bskur ba dang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa dang / phrin las 'chol ba ni med do/ /mdun bskyed dang 'brel na rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan mi 'dren par slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du thab dbus su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis spyan 'dren/ mchod g.yog pas mdun bskyed kyi drung nas me tog gis mtshon nas spyan 'dren pa'i tshul dang / gzhan rnams kyis rol chen bya/ mthar rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar rang rang gi gdan la 'khod zer dus mchod g.yogs pas me tog thab dbus su dor/ de nas sngar bzhin lha gsal gdab pa'i rjes su byon zan phul na/ rtsa rig brjod cing mar dgang blugs gsum dbul/ gong ma rnams su'ang byon zan phul na gdan la 'khod nas mchod bstod ma byas pa'i bar der so so'i sngags kyi rjes su ag+ne ye btags pas mar dgang blugs gsum dbul/ gzhung nas ma bshad pas ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar dang / lha thams cad kyi bstod pa bsdus pa tshigs bcad dgus bstod nas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi mchog tu bsams la/ thog mar gtso bo la oṃ sarba bid sogs kyi rjes su mar gyi sngags oṃ ag+ne ye swāhā zhes sogs dang /

gong gi spel tshig thog mtha' gnyis su btags pas rdzas bcu gcig po brgya rtsa brgyad/ sbyong rgyal la rang sngags kyi nyer gcig re dang / rigs gzhan gsum la rang sngags kyis bdun re dang / yum bzhi sde tshan gcig dang / sems dpa' bcu drug sde tshan bzhi dang / nang sgeg sogs bzhi gcig dang / phyi sgeg bzhi la sde tshan gcig sgo ba bzhi gcig tu byas nas rang sngags kyis bdun re dbul lo/ /mgron thabs kyi lha man chad la sde tshan lngar byas nas rtsa rig gis rdzas bcu gcig po bdun re dbul lo/ /sde tshan re re'i mthar mchod bstod byed na/ mchod pa re re dang rang rang gi bstod pas bstod do/ /yang na rdzas rnams bsres nas thams cad la rtsa rig kho nas phul bas chog go /yang khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal la gong gi sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa nyer gcig gis phul la/ bgegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas phyogs skyong dang bgegs rigs gang yin 'khor dang bcas pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes thab kyi phyogs gcig tu 'khod ces brjod la/ bsreg rdzas rnams rtsa rig gi lan gsum phul la/ bgegs dang log 'dren gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod/ yang bsreg rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs la chos skyong lcam dral rnams bkug nas rang sngags kyis bsreg rdzas rnams lan gsum phul la bar chad zhi bar gsol ba gdab/ yang rigs drug dang gzhi bdag rnams kyang bkug nas rtsa rig gis bsreg rdzas phul la/ rigs drug so so'i bsam pa tshim pa dang / longs spyod zad mi shes pa thob cing / sdug bsngal las grol nas myur du sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig ces brjod/ slar yang me lha nyid la sngar gyi spel tshig dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams phul la/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas ag+ne ye a kā ro sogs kyis bsngos la mchod bstod bya'o/

/de nas mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ thab rgyab kyi gtor ma gnyis dang po phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la cha gsum ltar byin/ gsum pa gzhi bdag la a kā ro'i sngags kyis bsngos nas 'dod pa'i don 'chol/ phyi ma gsum rigs drug dang / yi dwags dang / bgegs la bsngo'o/ /mdun bskyed dang 'brel na 'dir me lha dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma gnyis las med do/ /brgyad pa mjug gi bya ba ni/ rang nyid la dbang bskur ba nas bzod gsol gyi bar dkyil chog bzhin byas la/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyis lha rnams rang bzhiṃn gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ sngar dkyil 'khor las lha rnams spyan drangs pa yin na/ slob dpon gyis badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pa'i tshe/ mchod g.yog pas thab khung gi me tog gis mtshon nas lha rnams dkyil 'khor du spyan drangs par mos te/ rol chen dang bcas te me tog dkyil 'khor gyi drung du dor ro/ /dgu pa phan yon ni/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya 'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong nyid du/ /sbyin sreg byas par gyur na ni/ /dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yi/ /sdig pa de las thar bar gyur/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /'di dag ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg yin la/ las gsum gyi sbyin sreg gi khyad par rnams kyang gzhan phan 'od zer las shes par bya'o// //gal te ro sreg gi cho ga byed par 'dod na/ ro yon bdag gi tshul du sbyang ba dang / ro bla mchod kyi tshul du sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni gang zag phal pa la bya ste/ sngar gyi sbyin sreg gzhir byas pa la/ bsreg khang brtsigs nas/ thog mar bgegs zhi drag gis sbyang ba/ bum chus bkru ba/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs kyis brgyan pa/ ro lhar bsams nas mchod pa/ gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis byin gyis brlab pa/ gdags yig 'dogs pa/ bgegs bskrad cing rol mo byas te gos gdan dang bcas pa thab dbus su 'jog par gzhan phan 'od zer las gsungs pa ltar byas la/

dngos gzhi bsreg rdzas byin gyis rlob pa'i dus su ro'i sha rus dang bcas pa bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ lha'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sdig pa drang ba'i skabs su tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bkug nas bsregs par bsam/ spel tshig gi skabs su tshe 'das kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni gang zag mchog la bya ste/ chas gzhug gi tshul sngar dang 'dra ba las/ lhar bskyed pa'i skabs su gang zag de lha'i thugs dam rgyun du mdzad pa zhig yin na gdung de la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ sngar gyi lha thams cad gshegs su gsol te/ yang gsar du lha rnam snang lta bur bskyed nas mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas nas gzhag go /dngos gzhi'i lha'i 'od zer gyis sdig pa drang ba'i skabs su bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa bkug par bsam/ kun rig gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drang ba'i tshe sku gdung de dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha dbyer med du mos nas/ mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams dbul/ spel tshig gi skabs su bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /'di dag gi cho ga'i go rim dang / rgyud kyi tshig gang gis bstan pa'i tshul rnams la nges pa bskyed par 'dod na gzhan phan 'od zer du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni gzhan phan 'od zer gyi dgongs pa bzhin du bdag gi bla ma mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa'i phyag len las btus te las dang po ba dag gis gzung bde ba'i phyir du dge slong bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 go bo rab 'byams pa/ kun rig gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg
